jobs.title: Werkstudent Data & AI (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir sind BetterDoc, ein Digital-Health-Unternehmen mit über 200 Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Basel. Wir unterstützen Patienten mit schweren Erkrankungen und komplexen Diagnosen dabei, die passenden Spezialisten für ihr Anliegen zu finden. Dafür bündeln, strukturieren und analysieren wir qualitätsrelevante Daten aus dem Gesundheitswesen. Seit 2012 haben wir über 100.000 Patienten begleitet. Seit 2022 gehören wir zur Otto Group und arbeiten eng mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Medgate zusammen, einem der führenden Telemedizin-Anbieter Europas. Du studierst Medizin und probierst nebenbei schon aus, was mit KI alles geht? Bei uns bringst du beides zusammen. Du testest Prompts für echten Datenanfragen, prüfst KI-Ergebnisse mit deinem medizinischen Wissen und baust kleine Prototypen mit. Und du erlebst, wie daraus Produkte werden. Unser Team Medical Science ist der medizinische Kern von BetterDoc. Wir übersetzen medizinisches Wissen in Produkte: strukturierte Daten, Entscheidungslogik und zunehmend KI. Ärztinnen und Ärzte bauen bei uns selbst Prototypen und bringen sie gemeinsam mit Product und Engineering live. Als Werkstudent arbeitest du direkt in diesem Team mit. Zur Verstärkung suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) am Standort Köln oder remote. Deine Aufgaben Im Tagesgeschäft Medizinische Datenbank pflegen: Du hältst unsere medizinische Datenbank aktuell. Du recherchierst gezielt, bereitest Daten strukturiert auf und validierst sie systematisch. Analysen und Reportings: Du wirkst bei Auswertungen medizinischer Daten für interne Entscheidungen mit. Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hilfst dabei, Arbeitsprozesse und Konzepte rund um unsere Datenbank weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren. KI und Prototypen Prompts und Prototypen mitentwickeln: Du schreibst und testest Prompts und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team kleine Werkzeuge, zum Beispiel mit Claude, Python, SQL oder Google Apps Script. KI-Ergebnisse medizinisch prüfen: Du bewertest Ergebnisse unserer KI-Anwendu

jobs.description: Remi Health baut die digitale Infrastruktur für moderne Diagnostik in Europa. Unsere Diagnostics-as-a-Service-Plattform wird von Payern, Digital-Health- und Longevity-Companies, Pharma und Healthcare-Providern genutzt, um Diagnostik über eine einzige Integration in die eigenen Produkte einzubetten, ohne selbst Labor, Logistik, Regulatorik und medizinische Betreuung aufzubauen. Wir sind VC-finanziert, haben rund 5 Mio. € eingesammelt, über 1 Mio. Tests abgewickelt und sind in vier europäischen Märkten live, inklusive Versicherungspartnern. Das Team sitzt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir suchen eine:n Founder's Associate (m/w/d), der/die direkt mit unseren Gründern arbeitet und dort anpackt, wo es gerade am meisten bewegt: Marketing, Sales, Operations, Partnermanagement, interne Prozesse. Du bekommst keine abgesteckte Spur, sondern jede Woche echte Themen mit Verantwortung, und siehst nach sechs Monaten, wofür du brennst. Aufgaben Du arbeitest unseren Gründern direkt zu: Recherchen, Analysen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Follow-ups. Dabei übernimmst du Themen, die sonst liegen bleiben. Du unterstützt Sales und Partnermanagement: Lead-Recherche, Pflege unseres CRM (Close und HubSpot), Vorbereitung von Calls, Angeboten und Partnerunterlagen für unsere Gründer. Du hilfst beim Marketing: Content für LinkedIn und Newsletter, Landingpages, Kampagnen-Setups, Events und Messen. Du bereitest Zahlen und Reportings auf, die unsere Gründer und das Team für Entscheidungen brauchen. Du planst und koordinierst unsere Messeauftritte (Material, Logistik, Aufbau, Dienstleister) und sprichst vor Ort mit Partnern und Interessenten. jobs.title: Scientist - Patient Stratification, Biomarkers, Translational Genomics
jobs.description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. A Day in the Life At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health. This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders. For example, a Scientist may: Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies. jobs.title: Fractional Chief Medical Officer  - Tricorder Systems
jobs.description: Fractional Chief Medical Officer — Project Tricorder We're looking for a clinician who has served as a military medic to be Tricorder's clinical lead and the medical name behind the product. You'll shape clinical workflows, protect patient safety, help to roadmap clinical device regulation, giving the product credibility with clinicians, defence customers and investors. About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/ Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward. Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next. Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway. What you'll do You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe. Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios. Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
jobs.description: About Docplanner and Noa Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets. Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to: Remove their administrative work. Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most. Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context. We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care. The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role. About the role You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust. This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will: Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions. Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe. Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products. You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network. jobs.title: Head of Medical Coding, Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France. Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. Travel up to 40% (pilot hospitals, DGfM events), plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris. Team: you will recruit and
